color.description: Chip colour: a preset (`local`, `dev`, `test`, `staging`, `prod`) or a CSS hex colour (`#7c3aed`).

label.description: Short chip text (e.g. `QA`, `EU-PROD`); defaults to the colour preset's name.

protected.description: Ask before sending anything but GET/HEAD/OPTIONS while this environment is active.

secrets.description: Secret *names* only. Values live in the OS keychain (or a git-ignored `.env`).

secretSources.description:
Optional secret-manager references by secret name, e.g. `API_TOKEN: op://Eng/github/token`.
References are safe to commit; each teammate resolves them with their own CLI login.
